summary: Iteration 3 full-stack testing of Noxeal admin panel + AI automation. Backend: 58/59 pytest pass (98%). The 1 failure is EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhaustion on /api/admin/ai/suggest-topics (NOT a code bug — current cost 0.025 vs max 0.001 in litellm). All admin gating works (401 anon / 403 user / 200 admin) on every admin endpoint. Public /api/articles correctly excludes drafts via PUBLIC_STATUS_FILTER. Claude article generation returned a fully-shaped doc (slug unique, status='draft' by default, all required fields, valid category from the 5 allowed). publish:true correctly persists status='published'. Nano Banana image regen wrote a real PNG to /app/backend/static/images/ and the file is reachable at /api/static/images/{filename} (200 + image/png + >1KB). Publish/unpublish cycle round-trips correctly: unpublishing made the article 404 on public, publishing brought it back. Admin update endpoint validates empty body (400) and missing slug (404). Role update validates invalid role (400) and self-demotion (400). All iteration 1+2 regression tests still green (sitemap & robots now under /api/* — fixed by main agent — both pass). Frontend: anonymous → /admin redirects to /entrar?next=/admin; non-admin user → /admin redirects to /. Admin login + /admin renders centered control panel: 6 stat cards (9 / 8 / 1 / 5 / 5 / 20 = articles/published/drafts/comments/subscribers/users), all 5 tabs (Artículos, Generar con IA, Comentarios, Suscriptores, Usuarios), Articles list shows DRAFT/PUBLISHED status pills, IA badge on AI-generated articles, and per-article Editar/Publicar/Despublicar/Regenerar imagen IA/Ver/Eliminar buttons. Header conditionally shows 'ADMIN' link only for admin user. (Verified by leftover draft from main agent's dev testing: 'TikTok y la Generación Z…' showing DRAFT + IA badges.)

critical.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has hit its budget cap. litellm error: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.025671, Max budget: 0.001'. Once exceeded, ALL AI endpoints (suggest-topics, generate, regenerate-image) will return 500 with detail starting 'IA no respondió: ...'. Action: top up / regenerate the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY via the platform billing UI; the code itself is correct.

minor.issue: When a regenerated PNG already exists for a slug, the previous file in /app/backend/static/images/ is orphaned (never deleted). Over time the static dir will accumulate. Suggest deleting the previous file when image field starts with '/api/static/images/'.
ai.get('title') is sliced to [:160] but slugify caps at 80 chars — fine. However, if the AI returns a title >160 chars, the visible title is cut mid-word; consider rstrip + ellipsis.
Promoting a user to 'admin' is allowed silently — no audit log. For an admin/CEO/IA roles system this should at least be logged.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning logged on every admin page mount: 'An error occurred in the <HeroEditorialCard> component. Consider adding an error boundary…'. Page still renders fine but the warning suggests the card crashes when it's mounted on /admin (probably reading from /api/articles/featured which isn't relevant here). Wrap in error boundary or suppress mount on non-public routes.

issues: Article rows are correct but image thumbnail box for AI-generated drafts (image='') shows an empty grey square with placeholder icon — fine, but consider rendering a dashed outline + 'Sin imagen' label to make the empty state explicit.

action_items: URGENT: Refresh / increase budget on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — current cap is 0.001 USD which has already been exceeded by today's testing (used 0.025). Until refreshed, /api/admin/ai/suggest-topics, /api/admin/articles/generate, /api/admin/articles/{slug}/regenerate-image will all return 500 'IA no respondió'.
[Optional] Wrap <HeroEditorialCard> in an error boundary to silence the React 'An error occurred in the component' warning visible in admin pages.
[Optional] Delete previous PNG file when /admin/articles/{slug}/regenerate-image is called twice on the same article — currently orphans accumulate in /app/backend/static/images/.

[Optional] After the AI generates an article, the 'image' field is empty string. Frontend ArticleCard / Articulo handles this gracefully but the admin Articles list could show 'Sin imagen' explicitly.
[Carryover from iteration 2] Suppress console 401 noise from AuthContext probing /api/auth/me when anonymous.
[Carryover] Cookies set with secure=False; preview is HTTPS so secure=True + samesite='none' would be more correct for cross-site scenarios.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.generate_article_draft: trusts the model to return a JSON body that's a list of strings — if the model regresses and returns a single string the article body will be a string instead of list and the frontend rendering paragraphs via map() will crash. Add `if isinstance(data['body'], str): data['body'] = [data['body']]`.

server.py:admin_generate_article: image_keyword field is accepted from the model but never used downstream (only image_prompt is). Either remove it from the prompt schema or wire it into a future Unsplash fallback.

server.py:admin_publish_article sets 'published_at' to now() on every publish, which will REORDER articles on the public home if a long-existing draft is published. That is probably the right behavior, but document it — existing tests don't cover this ordering.

server.py admin_update_article allows setting hero/side/viral/trending booleans but does not enforce uniqueness on hero (only one article should have hero=True). Could lead to multiple heroes on the front page.
ai_service uses session_id with random uuid hex per request — that's fine for stateless calls but means no chat history reuse. Confirm intended.
server.py is now ~830 lines mixing auth, articles, admin, AI orchestration, SEO. Split into routers/auth.py, routers/articles.py, routers/admin.py, routers/seo.py.
No rate limit on /api/admin/articles/generate or /api/admin/articles/{slug}/regenerate-image — an admin (or compromised admin token) could rack up large LLM bills very quickly. Add a per-minute cap.
/api/admin/ai/suggest-topics returns 500 with the raw litellm error in the 'detail' field. That message is leaked verbatim to the client; consider a generic message + log the original.

rca of the issue: Single backend test failure RCA: /api/admin/ai/suggest-topics returned 500 'IA no respondió: Failed to generate chat completion: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.025671, Max budget: 0.001'. Sequence: pytest ran test_admin_generate_article_draft (Claude call ~$0.01) → test_admin_generate_article_publish_true (another Claude call ~$0.01) → test_admin_regenerate_image (Nano Banana call ~$0.005) which together pushed cost above the 0.001 cap, then test_admin_suggest_topics (alphabetically AFTER generate but BEFORE regenerate-image in pytest collection — actually order varies, but cumulative cost exceeded cap mid-run). Mitigation: top up EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget via platform UI; OR add a per-key spend guard at the ai_service level that returns 503 with a friendly message before invoking Claude/Nano Banana when month-to-date spend is near cap; OR move EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to a key with a higher budget.
